title: 49ers solicit Brandon Aiyuk trade offers after 2026 NFL Draft: 'Give us a call'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 49ers solicit Brandon Aiyuk trade offers after 2026 NFL Draft: 'Give us a call'
sources.description: The 49ers want to trade WR Brandon Aiyuk. They haven't yet found a partner, but John Lynch isn't giving up yet on doing so.
